'''2020 TMW Final Four Matthew Harrison-Trainor DS ISB Operations (2)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Final Four).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Final Four
